Pay frequency: Semimonthly or more frequent required (§ 34-28-3); salaried employees may be paid monthly (on/before 7th of following month).

Final pay on separation during/after promotion (§ 34-28-5): if termination occurs post-promotion, ensure all wages earned at promoted rate from effective date forward are paid within 24 hours (involuntary discharge) or on the next regular payday (voluntary resignation). Willful withholding triggers a penalty: wages continue to accrue at the same rate for up to 60 days.
